text:
Aisha K: quick q — who is authorized to flip the emergency flag for toggle/route-v2? need clarity before tomorrow's canary.
Ben S: only oncall SRE or SRE lead. platform eng can if paged and acked by SRE. must post in #incidents + #eng-oncall and create an audit entry.
Raj P: add that the person flipping should paste the audit id and a short reason in the thread. keeps things searchable.
Taylor M: +1. also recommend canary audience only: 0.5% for 5m then 5% for 10m. don't do global without :eyes: from SRE lead.
Aisha K: can we make the canary requirement enforced by policy?
Ben S: not enforced today — we rely on runbook + audits. ops-bot will record the flip automatically (helpful but not a gate).
ops-bot: Audit row created — flag=toggle/route-v2 action=prepare requester="Aisha K" incident=INC12345 id=aud_20240101_2245
Raj P: quick check command to inspect state:
Taylor M: ```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://internal-api.redwood/flags/toggle/route-v2 | jq .state
# returns: "off" / "canary:0.5" / "on"
```
Ben S: rollback command if flip goes bad:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"action":"rollback","reason":"safety"}' https://internal-api.redwood/flags/toggle/route-v2/actions
```
Aisha K: ok i'll page Ben when we need to flip tomorrow morning and will paste the audit id in the incident thread. I'll also update the runbook with the canary numbers + required notif channels.
Taylor M: i'll add a short checklist + a code snippet that auto-posts the audit id to #incidents. please include PR/commit link in the runbook entry.
Ben S: great. include a short revert plan: command + owner + ETA. :thumbsup:
Aisha K: thanks all — summary: only SRE oncall or lead flips (or platform eng with ack), canary 0.5%->5%->global, must page + post audit id + PR link. i'll push a runbook patch by EOD.
